_note: Manual draft-eligibility + age overrides the model can't infer. 'ineligible': players who cannot enter the draft (already been a pro / used their eligibility). 'age': real age (years) for players whose class year is unknown or misleading — feeds the draft-age penalty (NBA values youth). Keyed by exact player name. 'eligible_from': first NBA Draft a player can enter (reclassified high-schoolers too young for the next draft) — he is left off earlier boards and appears on that year's board. 'declared': players who stayed in the 2027 draft — kept on the 2027 board, off the 2028 board. 'returning': players who withdrew from the 2027 draft and went back to school — off the 2027 board (and mock), on the 2028 board as confirmed returners. Exact player names.
